name: Contribute
why: An outside contribution, from idea to production, with AI agents reviewing, merging and deploying it
ideal: An outside idea becomes a merged change within a day, no fork code runs with a secret, and no person waits in the loop.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Approving workflow runs from forks
GitHub Docs: Events that trigger workflows

steps.name: Idea
steps.rule: An idea starts in Discussions; an accepted one becomes a typed issue through a form.

steps.name: Approve run
steps.rule: Every outside contributor's run waits until the orchestrator reads the diff and approves it.

steps.name: Review
tools: gh pr view and gh pr diff only
steps.rule: Two AI reviews read the diff as data; fork code never runs on the owner's machine.

steps.name: Merge
steps.rule: Content paths merge at the checked head SHA; agents never approve a pull request.

steps.name: Rebuild
steps.rule: A build, CI or gate change is rebuilt as the orchestrator's pull request, crediting the contributor.

steps.name: Deploy
steps.rule: An outside commit soaks on staging, then deploys; a failed live check rolls back.
